Peasants and Workers Party of India

elections.notes: Polling on 24, 27 and 28 December 1984. Assam and Punjab voted in 1985; the article lists those 27 seats in a separate table, so they are not included here. Totals are the article's main results table: 514 elected seats plus 2 appointed Anglo-Indian members (516). The infobox's 414 seats for Congress (I) include the 10 it won in 1985. Turnout (63.56%) is computed from this table's electorate and votes cast; the infobox's 64.01% covers the 1984 and 1985 polls together. Congress (R) and Congress (I) rows use the inc key: Wikipedia says that faction was recognised as the Indian National Congress, and it dropped the "(Indira)" suffix in 1996. The table has no seat-change column.
